# Timing Test v0.3 (Patrik Rak)

Instruction and contention timing test by Patrik Rak, based on Jan Bobrowski's zxtests. License: GPL (stated in
`timing.bas`). Unmodified copy of `timingtest-0.3.zip`:

- zxe.io depot: `Timing Test v0.3 (2013-12-09)(Rak, Patrik)[!].zip`
- original: http://zxds.raxoft.cz/taps/misc/timingtest-0.3.zip

Published result screens (48K early / late, 128K early / late, +2A/+3) are listed on the ZX Spectrum tests wiki
(https://github.com/redcode/ZXSpectrum/wiki/Timing-Test). The grids the tests compare against are transcribed from
them in `core/tests/emulator/video/contentionprobe_test.cpp` (`RakCases`).
